value_basis.combat: same-day API options, maximum verified equipment/hyper/ability/union preset combination including confirmed owned compatible Android equip combinations including confirmed Master Label Plus appearance choices; cash item stats from stat-bearing base slots only excluding named training equipment presets

ranking_basis: calculated preset combat_power descending; exact equipped baseline validation required
candidate_discovery: ranking/overall API for names only; includes level 289 as a date-boundary buffer
notes: Maximum projectile ownership is assumed: arrows +9, throwing stars +29, bullets +22. Inventory is not observed. Exact equipped baseline and all other preset checks remain required.
All game data uses the requested API calendar date; collection.as_of is the publication cutoff, not a minute-specific game snapshot.
Interim rankings compare verified API records as of collection.as_of; pending candidates are not included.
Candidate count includes the level 289 date-boundary buffer and is not the final eligible population.
Counts are a publication snapshot, not a live progress counter.
